\n<Tomiyoshi>Ah, it seems I've forgotten my manners today!

\n<Tomiyoshi>My main occupation is food and catering, but I also

\n<Tomiyoshi>But now, as for the reason why I called you here...
\n<Tomiyoshi>The Red Brick recognizes you as a skilled trainer,
and as its owner, I'd like to ask a favor of you.
Would you hear me out?
\n<Tomiyoshi>You see, a great auction will be held soon, one with
many important people in attendance. Many sorts of
goods will be sold there, old and new, and...
\n<Tomiyoshi>Our humble establishment would like to bring one of
your products to auction off at this special event.

request? I'm sure you do... I want you to bring your

product worthy of the event, we'll make you so rich
you won't have to work another day in your life.

\n<Tomiyoshi>If you can provide us with such a great specimen,

\n<Tomiyoshi>The day of the auction is not upon us quite yet, so

know that I'll be eagerly awaiting your answer.
\n<Tomiyoshi>When you've made up your mind, talk to the man

\n<Tomiyoshi>I'm terribly sorry for taking up so much of your
